items.raw_excerpt: The state currently offers free public interpreters for essential services in Norway. However, a new parliamentary proposal may change this arrangement. What exactly is on the table?
items.summary_en: Norway currently provides free public interpreters for essential services to help foreign residents access healthcare and other important services. A new parliamentary proposal could end this free service for those who have lived in the country for a long time. The change would affect how long-term foreign residents receive language support in official situations.

items.raw_excerpt: Security staff at Schiphol will begin short work stoppages and deliberately slow-downs in the coming days, after the airport and its three security firms missed a union deadline to ease a workload the unions say has become unmanageable. Travellers could face longer queues as a result. Unions FNV and CNV announced the action on Wednesday, after an ultimatum to Schiphol and the firms Securitas, I-SEC and Trigion expired at midday. The stoppages will be flagged only a few hours in...

items.raw_excerpt: An online researcher may have made a breakthrough in the hunt for the identity of “Lucky”, a man who collapsed in Amsterdam three years ago and is unable to communicate. A recent public appeal for information by the police has surfaced a potential match with a missing person in Canada. An image of “Lucky”, who was also known by the name “Chris the Canadian” to Amsterdam locals, was likened to a file of pictures on the Vancouver Police Department’s cold...
items.summary_en: An online researcher may have identified a man known as 'Lucky' who collapsed in Amsterdam three years ago. The man, called 'Chris the Canadian' by locals, has been unable to communicate since. Police found a potential match with a missing person file from Vancouver, Canada.

items.raw_excerpt: The Waimakariri Mayor says the decision to decline a controversial plan to rip up Canterbury's Pegasus Golf Course under fast-track approval is a wonderful win for the community.
items.summary_en: A property developer planned to turn the 18-hole Pegasus Golf Course into 1,000 homes. The community gathered over 16,000 signatures and fought the fast-track plan. The Infrastructure Minister declined to refer the project, calling it a win for the community.

items.raw_excerpt: Austria has assessed almost €1 million in unpaid vehicle taxes after a nationwide crackdown on foreign-plated vehicles. For people who brought a vehicle from abroad, the registration deadline can come up surprisingly quickly.
